instructions:
Wear headphones for better experience.

Use TurboWarp for better experience.
https://turbowarp.org/1022807402/embed

If any question marks showed up, reload the webpage until they disappear. They appear because some frames are not loaded correctly.

I removed the Thumbnail because that seems to be the question mark showing up in the center. (If it still appears, simply reload the page without leaving the browser.)
 
Read Through Instructions!
Wait for the project to load because it contains over 1000 frames, making the file size relatively big.
Click the green flag to start. It will go through an approximately 1-minute initializing when started for the first time and then automatically move on.
If the frame rate is still low after initializing, restart the project multiple times to make sure all frames are loaded.
Once started, this project will run forever, to stop it, click the red stop sign.
Turn off full screen if the animation cannot catch up with the music.
